      • getWalletId

        public String getWalletId()
        Type of wallet, values are assigned by card schemes, e.g.
        • 101 for MasterPass in eCommerce
        • 102 for MasterPass NFC
        • 103 for Apple Pay
        • 216 for Google Pay
        • 217 for Samsung Pay
        • 327 to indicate the usage of Network tokens in the transaction
